```{r}
#| label: testing-effect
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
source(here::here("resources/viz-setup.R"))

testing_effect_data <- tibble(
  condition = factor(
    c("4\u00d7 Studieren", "3\u00d7 Studieren +\n1\u00d7 Test", "1\u00d7 Studieren +\n3\u00d7 Tests"),
    levels = c("4\u00d7 Studieren", "3\u00d7 Studieren +\n1\u00d7 Test", "1\u00d7 Studieren +\n3\u00d7 Tests")
  ),
  retention = c(40, 56, 61)
)

ggplot(testing_effect_data, aes(x = condition, y = retention)) +
  geom_col(
    aes(fill = retention),
    width = 0.65,
    color = brand_dark,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(retention, "%")),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = brand_dark,
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f0a5bb", high = brand_accent, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 70),
    breaks = seq(0, 60, 20),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 60, 20), "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Testing Effekt",
    subtitle = "Aktives Abrufen führt zu besserem Langzeitlernen als wiederholtes Studieren",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Erinnerung nach 1 Woche (%)",
    caption = "Daten basierend auf Roediger & Karpicke (2006)"
  ) +
  theme_workshop() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", lineheight = 1.1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```
